public_rationale: Language Log's December 8, 2022 article quotes Marcus's November 22, 2022 warning that LLMs are inherently unreliable and can make things up [e1]. A May 8, 2023 CTech interview records another reliability warning and his concerns about fabricated ChatGPT answers [e2]. These records establish repeated warnings across months before February 17, 2024, supporting the claim that he had warned about this for quite some time [e1, e2].
limitations: These records establish that Marcus issued warnings, not that their substance was correct.
The evidence does not establish his earliest warning or provide an exhaustive history.
The claim specifies no minimum duration for “quite some time.”

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Gary Marcus has been warning about the fundamental untrustworthiness of LLM-powered chatbots for quite some time.

statement.excerpt: Gary Marcus has been warning about the fundamental untrustworthiness of LLM-powered chatbots for quite some time.
statement.document_title: Death of a Chatbot, body blow to an industry

our_interpretation: This is a claim about Marcus's public record of warnings, not a claim that those warnings have been proved correct.
The plain reading requires repeated warnings over an extended period before the post, reasonably understood as months or longer, rather than a warning first made during this incident.
Fundamental untrustworthiness means warnings about inherent factual unreliability or fabricated answers, rather than unrelated concerns about AI.
The target period is the history preceding the post. No starting date is supplied, so its start remains unspecified.
For quite some time describes duration; it is not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records show Marcus repeatedly warning, across an extended period before February 17, 2024, that LLM-based conversational systems are inherently unreliable or produce fabricated information.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish that the attributed warnings were not his, concerned a different subject, or began only immediately before the post, contrary to the claimed extended history.
